title: Etaleness descends to a finite stage of a limit
statement: Let $I$ be a directed set and $(S_i,f_{ii'})$ an inverse system of schemes [def-pc-scheme] over $I$ with affine transition morphisms [pqf-def-affine-morphism], with limit $S=\varprojlim_iS_i$ [lem-weil-pbc-limit-affine-transition]. Let $0\in I$ and let $f_0:X_0\to Y_0$ be a morphism of schemes over $S_0$, where $S_0$, $X_0$, $Y_0$ are quasi-compact and quasi-separated [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]. For $i\ge0$ let $f_i:X_i\to Y_i$ be the base change of $f_0$ to $S_i$ ($X_i=X_0\times_{S_0}S_i$, $Y_i=Y_0\times_{S_0}S_i$, fibre products [def-pc-fibre-product]) and $f:X\to Y$ its base change to $S$. If $f$ is etale [def-weil-etale-morphism] and $f_0$ is locally of finite presentation [def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation], then $f_i$ is etale for some $i\ge0$ (Stacks Limits, Lemma 07RP).

source.place: Lemma Tag 07RP (lemma-descend-etale, line 1949), in Situation Tag 081D (situation-descent-property, line 1739); its proof: etale is local on source and target (Morphisms, Lemma Tag 02GJ, lemma-etale-characterize, morphisms.tex line 8090; the source cites it by label, the tag 02GN given here before is lemma-composition-etale), reducing to $S_0,X_0,Y_0$ affine ('details omitted'), where it is Algebra, Lemma Tag 07RI (lemma-colimit-etale, algebra.tex line 47626)

proof.text: For each x in X₀ choose an affine W around g₀(f₀(x)), an affine V inside g₀⁻¹(W) around f₀(x), and an affine U inside f₀⁻¹(V) around x, using [lem-weil-pbc-affine-opens-basis]. The restriction of the étale limit map to the preimage of U is étale by composition with its open inclusion [lem-weil-pbc-etale-composition-cancellation]. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-etale-affine-chart-descent] to get an index k(x) and étaleness on this chart at all later indices.

The chosen U(x) cover X₀ because each contains x. Quasi-compactness [def-weil-pbc-quasi-compact-scheme] gives a finite subcover indexed by a finite subset s⊆X₀. This is exactly IsCompact.elim_finite_subcover applied to the chosen family.

Directedness gives an upper bound i of the finite set {i₀}∪{k(x) | x∈s}. Formally this is Finset.exists_le, proved by induction on the finite set using the directed common-upper-bound property; inserting i₀ also handles the empty-source case. Inverse images of the finite covering under Xᵢ→X₀ cover Xᵢ, because preimage preserves unions and the top open. Each resulting chart map to Yᵢ is étale by the all-later clause of [lem-weil-pbc-etale-affine-chart-descent].
Apply [lem-weil-pbc-etale-local-on-source] to the covering of Xᵢ just constructed. This proves étaleness of the full Over.pullback morphism at i, with the required proof i₀≤i.

lean.statement: theorem Etale.exists_stage_of_inverseLimit {I : Type u} [Preorder I] [IsDirected I (· ≤ ·)] (D : Iᵒᵖ ⥤ Scheme.{u}) [∀ {i j : Iᵒᵖ} (a : i ⟶ j), IsAffineHom (D.map a)] (c : Cone D) (hc : IsLimit c) (i₀ : I) [CompactSpace (D.obj (op i₀))] [QuasiSeparatedSpace (D.obj (op i₀))] (X₀ Y₀ : Over (D.obj (op i₀))) [CompactSpace X₀.left] [QuasiSeparatedSpace X₀.left] [CompactSpace Y₀.left] [QuasiSeparatedSpace Y₀.left] (f₀ : X₀ ⟶ Y₀) [LocallyOfFinitePresentation f₀.left] (hf : Etale (((Over.pullback (c.π.app (op i₀))).map f₀).left)) : ∃ (i : I) (h : i₀ ≤ i), Etale (((Over.pullback (D.map (homOfLE h).op)).map f₀).left)
